title: release-cutover-checklist-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-16-maya
content:
Daily scratchpad: release cutover (notes to self) - 2026-03-16

Context:
- Release: r2026.3.16
- Primary change: optimized KV-cache eviction + fallback routing for small models
- Cutover lead: Maya (me), oncall: Jordan, SRE lead: Ellis
- Target MTR: 09:00-11:00 PT (main window) + 1h monitoring post

Before cutover (BY 08:15):
- [ ] Confirm infra green (grafana quick check: infra-overview, gpu-pools, queue-length)
- [ ] Confirm release artifacts built: docker images uploaded to registry (sha tag present) -> run `./scripts/verify-images.sh r2026.3.16`
- [ ] Confirm DB migrations staged and reviewed (REL-4321)
- [ ] Confirm canary tests passing on staging (smoketests: auth, healthcheck, infer-smoke)
- [ ] Notify #releases slack: 08:20 PT pre-cutover ping with checklist link
- [ ] Stakeholders CC: Eng PM, Prod, Ops, CS (short note — ETA, rollback plan)

Cutover checklist (09:00 PT START):
- 09:00 - pause automated deploys (CI -> hold)
- 09:02 - scale down non-critical batch jobs to free GPU capacity (run `k scale` jobs)
- 09:05 - deploy model runtime image to dedicated pool canary (node set: canary-1)
  - Watch: canary logs for OOM, kv-cache errors, kernel fallback logs
  - Run quick perf: 5 requests across models (gpt-small, gpt-medium) latency + correctness
- 09:20 - if canary stable -> ramp to 10% traffic; monitor (QPS, p95 latency, error-rate)
- 09:35 - if metrics OK -> ramp to 50% then 100% over next 10m
- 09:50 - post-deploy smoke: run end-to-end test suite (script: `tests/e2e/cutover-smoke.sh`)

Backports & hotfixes:
- If user-facing regression: prioritize patch on main -> cherry-pick the fix to release branch -> rebuild image -> deploy to canary
- Known potential backport: KV eviction edge-case (ticket REL-4338) -> keep branch ready (branch: hotfix/kv-evict)
- Manual steps for backport ready: `git cherry-pick <hash>`, `make image && ./scripts/push-image.sh`

Rollback plan (if >threshold errors or latency spike >30% p95):
- Stop ramp, switch routing to previous model runtime image tag (r2026.3.15) using routing policy rollback command: `infra route set --model-runtime r2026.3.15 --policy fallback-immediate`
- Notify #releases and open incident channel if SLOs broken

Comms (short messages to send):
- Pre-cutover (08:20): "Heads-up: starting release r2026.3.16 at 09:00 PT. Expected roar window 09:00-11:00 PT. If you see anomalies, ping #releases or @JordanKim on pager."
- Canary OK (09:25): "Canary looks healthy: latency and error-rate within baseline. Ramping to 50%."
- Full cutover (10:00): "Release r2026.3.16 complete. Monitoring for 1h. Contact Maya for questions."
- Rollback: short note with reason and rollback tag

Post-cutover (within 1h):
- [ ] Run regression evals on recent prompt-suite (evals/regression/run.sh) -> record any quality drift
- [ ] Export cost/latency baseline from observability dashboard for the last 2h
- [ ] Merge any small post-cut hotfixes and schedule follow-up postmortem if required
- [ ] Update runbook with any deviations observed today

Commands & shortcuts (notes to self):
- Verify images: `./scripts/verify-images.sh r2026.3.16`
- Rollback routing: `infra route set --model-runtime r2026.3.15 --policy fallback-immediate`
- Scale jobs: `kubectl scale deployment batch-worker --replicas=0 -n infra-jobs`
- Check rollout status: `kubectl rollout status deployment/runtime -n prod`

Monitoring quick checklist (what to watch):
- infra/gpu-pools: utilization + OOMs
- runtime/p95-latency by model size
- errors: 5xx by endpoint (generation, embeddings)
- tracing: increased tail latency on streaming responses (look for kv-cache misses)

Open questions / TODOs (for follow-up):
- Should we enable adaptive-batching for small models in this release or leave for next? (ask research/infra)
- Confirm if Dedicated customers saw any transient errors historically from similar patches (lookup incidents REL-2025-07)
- Add a one-liner in the release notes about KV-cache behavior and fallback routing

Random scratch notes (keep short):
- Ellis: confirm SLO thresholds for p95 change detection (is it 20% or 30% baseline?)
- Jordan: will be on pager until 13:00 PT
- Keep PR #5678 handy for quick rollback check

End-of-day reminders:
- Add any postmortem notes to Confluence (page: Release Runbook - Mar 2026)
- If rollback happened, file incident and tag REL-xxxx

-- Maya
